name: deucalion-hpc-check
description: Offline diagnostics for Deucalion GNU Make and Slurm files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Validation reads open document text locally and never executes files, starts processes, or accesses the network.

deucalionHpc.enabled.description: Enable or disable Deucalion HPC diagnostics across the editor or for the current workspace/folder.

deucalionHpc.disabledWorkspaces.description: List of workspace names or directory paths where Deucalion HPC validation is disabled.

deucalionHpc.enabledWorkspaces.description: When non-empty, Deucalion HPC validation is enabled only for matching workspace names or directory paths.

deucalionHpc.makefile.enabled.description: Enable or disable GNU Makefile syntax and recipe indentation checks.

deucalionHpc.slurm.enabled.description: Enable or disable Slurm sbatch script checks.

deucalionHpc.disabledRules.description: List of rule codes to disable (e.g. ['makefile.space-indented-recipe', 'SBATCH_DYNAMIC_VALUE']). Prefix wildcards such as 'makefile.*' are supported.

deucalionHpc.rules.description: Map of individual rule codes to their enabled state (e.g. {"SBATCH_DYNAMIC_VALUE": false}).
